system.description:
You must be under the effects of your Medical Fist taijutsu stance, Hanami Style: Defensive Cloak and Hanami Style: Offensive Cloak clan Hijutsu to cast this jutsu.

A last-ditch technique of the Hanami Clan, You use your finite control of medical chakra, spreading it throughout yourself. Your veins begin to glow a dark magenta as the chakra spreads throughout your chakra network. You end concentration on both the Defensive and Offensive cloaks as this jutsu takes effect. You cannot concentrate on another Hanami Clan Hijutsu jutsu while this jutsu is active. While under the effects of this jutsu you gain the following benefits:

When a creature hits you with a melee attack, they take 2d12 Necrotic damage and you regain an equal amount of Hit Points.

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes 3d6 and can deal poison or necrotic damage, additionally when you deal damage to a creature with a melee attack, they are unable to regain hit points until the end of their next turn.

When you score a critical hit with a Medical or Taijutsu, you instead triple your unarmed damage die.

At the conclusion of this jutsu, you are no longer able to mold chakra until you complete a rest, as your chakra network is throttled by your overuse.
